name: query_incident_history
description: Query DynamoDB for past incidents of the specified type to inform current reasoning.

incident_type.description: The alarm name or incident type to search history for.

limit.description: Maximum number of past incidents to return. Defaults to 5.

session_id.description: Workshop lab session id, if scoping history to one learner's session.

name: post_to_slack
description: Post a structured incident analysis and decision to a Slack channel via Incoming Webhook.

message.description: The complete incident analysis including classification, reasoning, and recommended actions.

severity.description: Severity level for formatting: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, or INFO.

webhook_url.description: Slack Incoming Webhook URL for this session, if not configured via Secrets Manager.

name: restart_ecs_service
description: Force a new ECS deployment to restart all tasks in the specified service. Only operates on operator-zero-cluster.

cluster_name.description: ECS cluster name. Defaults to operator-zero-cluster.

service_name.description: ECS service name. Defaults to operator-zero-service.

reason.description: Why this restart is being triggered, for the audit trail.

name: verify_ecs_service_health
description: Check running vs desired task count for an ECS service to confirm recovery after a restart.

cluster_name.description: ECS cluster name. Defaults to operator-zero-cluster.

service_name.description: ECS service name. Defaults to operator-zero-service.

name: diagnose_incident
description: Delegate root-cause analysis to the Diagnostics Harness. Returns a structured assessment with confidence score and recommended action.

incident_description.description: Full incident details: what triggered it, current state, and any known context.

alarm_name.description: The CloudWatch alarm or event name that triggered this incident.

name: execute_remediation
description: Delegate healing to the Remediation Harness. Restarts the ECS service and verifies recovery. Only call after Diagnostics returns HIGH confidence REMEDIATE_AUTOMATICALLY.

service_name.description: ECS service name to remediate. Defaults to operator-zero-service.

reason.description: The root cause and justification from the Diagnostics assessment.

name: record_incident_outcome
description: Write the final incident report to DynamoDB. Always call this as the last step, regardless of outcome.

incident_type.description: The alarm name or incident type.

diagnostics_summary.description: Summary of what the Diagnostics Harness found.

severity.description: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, or INFO.
